description: This file is the main login page for the TestLink open-source project. It handles user authentication, including login validation, session management, OAuth provider integration, SSO handling, and rendering the login interface. It manages various login flows such as normal login, Ajax login, OAuth, and SSO, as well as security checks and redirection after successful login.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class used for parameter validation and sanitization for input arguments.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template engine integration for rendering login interface.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the application configuration is valid.

methods.name: doDBConnect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection with error handling.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes input parameters received from the login request.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI elements and configuration settings for rendering login screen.

methods.name: doBlockingChecks
methods.description: Performs schema verification and prevents login if schema is outdated.

methods.name: renderLoginScreen
methods.description: Renders the login interface with security notes and background images.

methods.name: authorizePostProcessing
methods.description: Handles post-authorization tasks such as redirection or error messaging.

methods.name: processAjaxCheck
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to check session validity and responds with JSON.

methods.name: cleanInput
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to prevent script injection and HTML tags.
